title: Pipedrive API Review [August 2026]: Features & Limits
snippet:
**Pipedrive's API** is a mature REST surface with two active versions (v1 and v2), [OAuth 2.0 support](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Oauth), published [OpenAPI 3 specs](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1), official SDKs for Node.js and PHP, full [webhook support](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/guide-for-webhooks-v2), and API access on every plan, including the entry-level Lite tier.

| **Pricing / access** | API access included on all plans, including Lite ($14/month per seat) |

| API access on every plan, including the $14/month Lite tier | Token-based daily budget shared across all users in the company account |

Getting API access requires a paid **Pipedrive** account on any plan. The Lite tier at [$14/month per seat](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm-comparison/pipedrive-vs-hubspot) includes full API access, and a [free developer sandbox account](https://developers.pipedrive.com/) lets you build and test integrations without touching production data.

The [plan tiers](https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/how-does-pricing-work-in-pipedrive) (per seat, per month):
- **Lite:** $14/month (the entry point; includes API access, webhooks, and Marketplace integrations)
- **Growth:** Adds email sync, automations, sequences, and 2x API token budget
- **Premium:** Adds Smart Docs, Projects, LeadBooster, and 5x API token budget
- **Ultimate:** Highest limits across the board, 7x API token budget

A five-seat team on the Lite plan gets 150,000 tokens per day. If your integration hits complex endpoints often (which consume more tokens), you will need either a higher-tier plan or purchased top-ups. [API token top-ups](https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/top-ups) are available from Growth onward at 250,000 tokens per unit, up to 10 units.
The [14-day free trial](https://www.pipedrive.com) includes full API access with no credit card required, and the [free developer sandbox](https://developers.pipedrive.com/) is available indefinitely for building and testing integrations.

API access is included on every paid Pipedrive plan, starting at $14/month per seat on the Lite tier. There are no per-call charges or separate API subscriptions. The practical cost constraint is the daily token budget, which scales with plan tier and seat count (30,000 base tokens x plan multiplier x seats).

title: CRM API | REST API integration
snippet:
##### Free API access with every plan
Grab your API token and unlock a world of possibilities with our RESTful Pipedrive API v1. Access what you need via webhooks, API endpoints, Postman, Insomnia, client libraries, SDKs and more.

## Access the Pipedrive CRM API for free
Every Pipedrive plan comes with an API token that gives you access to our RESTful API for free. This means you can extend and customize your Pipedrive experience to streamline your business processes and improve your CRM software’s functionality and efficiency.
- Pull call lists and customer information and make them appear in your call center software
- Create new leads based on shared custom data in your data warehouse or any other tool in your tech stack
- Assign new tasks to your after-sales team via project management software once a deal is closed
- Integrate marketing automation and communication tools so you can streamline workflows and never miss notifications

Access to the Pipedrive API is only possible using the API key or an access token when using OAuth 2.0. Not only does Pipedrive encrypt disks and enforce HTTPS from outside the network, but certain data inside the database is also encrypted when necessary.
